name: Ono (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ono city emblem in red: a ring enclosing a stylised device of pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ono, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 December 1964; the emblem dates from 1 December 1954.

features.role: Ono city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised device of pointed strokes
